summary: Corrected the recorded batching premise and submitted the boundary experiment. The correction (changed_premise on knowledge 29e4214f5ee146b393957fa23a33a73d-knowledge-0, with the three affected interpretation IDs listed) records that processLogs' batch count follows the entries prepareLog turns into commit tuples (commands, barriers, and configuration entries only above protocol version 2), so no-op entries consume no batch slot and any count derived from a log index range is an upper bound. The fixed experiment in draft/assurance_generated_test.go places the boundary exactly: prefix targets 2049 and 2050 with MaxAppendEntries 16, where the harness now reports delivered tuples and batches as well as the entry-based count. Local construction feedback gave 2048 tuples/128 batches returning in 1ms and 2049 tuples/129 batches not returning within 8000ms with the replay frames in the stack, so the two comparisons assert that each restart must return; the retained receipt is requested.
